# Muzart Music & Art School

> > Muzart is an RCM-certified music and art school in Etobicoke offering professional lessons in piano, guitar, drums, voice, and visual arts for all ages starting from $35 trials.

Muzart Music & Art School has been serving the Etobicoke and Toronto community since 2010, providing specialized instruction in both music and visual arts. The school features RCM-certified teachers, professional sound-isolated studios, and offers specialized preparation for university art programs (OCAD, ESA) and RCM examinations.

## Key Topics

- RCM Certification
- Piano Lessons
- Guitar Lessons
- Drum Lessons
- Singing/Voice Lessons
- Art Classes
- Portfolio Preparation
- OCAD & ESA Prep
- Trial Lessons
- All Ages Instruction
- Toronto & Etobicoke
- Professional Studios
- Group & Private Lessons
- Music Theory
